activity_summary: At the orchard door you looked at the bench and did not sit. The stone was where you had put it back. The sheet stayed on the bench. Anne said the eighteenth was not tonight. You came in.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked, and came in without sitting.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Held him to the morning, and named the eighteenth as not tonight.

entities.name: Joan Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused him a light in the apples, and wanted the hall left clear.
